mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (if non-Hague state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry, government authority or internationally recognized sanctions screening provider

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers, and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN; EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; UN Security Council Consolidated List; Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (CRF) bulletins; CSSF Circular 17/02 PEP and risk-flagging standards. Enhanced due diligence mandatory if a UBO or family member is a PEP. Negative media and adverse legal-integrity checks must be documented. Source of wealth and source of funds declarations are required for any beneficial owner, especially where trading volumes exceed EUR 50,000 per transaction or where SWIFT TT and documentary LC payment rails are used.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers - LBR (lbr.lu) / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be entered in Latin script. The name may include French, German, or Luxembourgish characters; all statutory filings are in French. The name must be distinguishable from existing names in the RCS and must not be misleading as to the company's legal form, activity, or regulated status. Any transliteration from a non-Latin script must be notarized and filed with a sworn translation into French.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RCS rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Director of the Luxembourg Business Registers within 15 days of rejection. A reasoned memorandum distinguishing the applied name from conflicting marks and justifying the distinctive elements must be attached. The reservation may be extended for one additional 30-day period upon written request to LBR before expiry, subject to payment of the applicable extension fee. If the appeal is dismissed, a fresh tentative name reservation may be lodged with an entirely distinct name core; resubmitting the same protested name is not permitted without judicial relief from the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible. The target activity (ISIC 4669 - cross-border physical consignment of shredded non-ferrous scrap) is statutorily licensed under the Luxembourg law of 2 September 2011 on access to the craft trades, commerce and small business. A virtual office will not satisfy the required commercial premise test. A physical, operational registered office with a local director or a dedicated substance agent and staff capable of managing trade documentation, warehouse inspections and regulatory audits is mandatory. For VAT, customs and recyclable-material trading permits, the Luxembourg tax and customs authorities apply a strict economic substance doctrine.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (70%) - Unannounced on-site inspections are probable within the first 24 months, given the 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced' AML classification and the sector's exposure to cross-border movement of recyclable metals. The Ministry of Economy, the Social Security Centre (CNSS), the Luxembourg tax authorities, and the AML supervision authority retain the right to conduct physical, unannounced controls under the licensing and AML/CFT statutes.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Articles 710-1 to 710-23 governing SARL); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies and on the Accounting Records; Law of 2 September 2011 on Access to Professions
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), 14-18 rue Erasme, L-2082 Luxembourg; electronic filing via guichet.lu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Charter of Incorporation (Statuts constitutifs) executed by notarial deed, registered with the RCS and published in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 12,000 minimum fully subscribed and paid-up capital for SARL; cash contributions must be deposited into a blocked account with a Luxembourg credit institution and evidenced by a bank blocking certificate annexed to the notarial deed; no separate statutory escrow agent required under Luxembourg law
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS RESOLUTION OF THE SHAREHOLDERS OF [SARL NAME] (Stage 2) RESOLVED, that each shareholder subscribes to the number of shares set opposite their name in the Articles of Association, and that the share capital is fully paid up as evidenced by the bank blocking certificate attached to the notarial deed. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the company is fixed at [Address], L-xxxx Luxembourg, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. RESOLVED, that [Name] and [Name] are appointed managers (gérants), each acting singly, and are authorised to complete the RCS registration, obtain the establishment permit, register for VAT and environmental permits, and open bank accounts of the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary public (Notaire) for the arrondissement of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Luxembourg notary to draft and execute the articles of association (Statuts) pursuant to the Law of 10 August 1915. The deed must include corporate name, registered office in Luxembourg, corporate object (wholesale of recycled scrap copper wire, ISIC 4669), duration, share capital, and manager powers. All shareholders or duly authorised proxy holders must sign before the notary. The notary then transmits the deed to the RCS.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID of each shareholder
Proof of residential address of each shareholder
Draft Articles of Association (Statuts)
Statement of good repute / non-conviction for each manager
Written power of attorney if signing by proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS queries the deed, the notary files a supplemental rectification deed (acte rectificatif) within one month; if the query concerns shareholder consent, obtain fresh signatures or confirmations before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Share Capital Deposit and Bank Blocking Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (bank) selected by the founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked capital account in the name of the future SARL. Transfer a minimum of EUR 12,000 in cash from shareholders and instruct the bank to issue a capital blocking certificate (attestation de blocage) addressed to the notary. Funds remain blocked until RCS registration and are released thereafter for operational use.
required_dossiers: Statuts draft or notarial deed reference
Bank KYC and AML forms for all shareholders and managers
Source of funds declaration and evidence
Copy of shareholder identification documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays or refuses the certificate due to AML queries, submit enhanced source-of-wealth documentation within 10 business days; if the account is rejected, open a substitute account with another Luxembourg credit institution and issue a new certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) via guichet.lu or through the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of the notarial deed, file the registration application electronically with the RCS. Attach the notarized deed, bank capital certificate, manager identity documents, and signed statements. Pay the RCS filing fee. The RCS reviews legality and issues the RCS registration number.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Bank blocking certificate for share capital
Manager identification and statement of acceptance
Statement of honour (déclaration de non-condamnation) for managers
Consent of owner for use of registered office premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration file is queried, correct the notified defects within one month; a written extension may be requested. If the RCS issues a refusal, file an administrative appeal with the RCS registrar or seek judicial review before the District Court of Luxembourg.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Electronic Register of Companies (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA), operated by the Luxembourg government
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registration, the RCS transmits the incorporation extract for mandatory electronic publication in RESA. Verify that the published extract accurately reflects the corporate name, registered office, share capital, managers, and corporate object. The publication date determines third-party effectiveness of the incorporation.
required_dossiers: RCS registration receipt
Incorporation extract (extrait du RCS)
Validation of published data by the notary or managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed, contact the RCS publication desk or the notary to expedite; typographical errors in the published extract are corrected by submitting a formal request for rectification to the RCS within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministère de l'Économie (Ministry of the Economy) via the Guichet.lu single window and the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the permit application under the Law of 2 September 2011 on Access to Professions within three months of RCS registration. Demonstrate manager professional competence (typically four years of relevant experience in trading or scrap metal activities) and good repute. The permit becomes effective retroactively to the date of application if granted.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract
Criminal record (bulletin n°3) for each manager
Professional experience certificates or diploma
Description of registered office and storage premises
Declaration of honour on compliance with REACH and circular economy obligations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused, lodge a hierarchical appeal (recours gracieux) with the Ministry of the Economy within one month, then an administrative appeal to the Administrative Tribunal of Luxembourg within three months; if the Ministry remains silent after three months, file a reminder to trigger a deemed decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'Environnement (Luxembourg Environment Agency) and the commune (municipality) of the physical site
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a class 2 waste installation application to the municipal administration, including a technical dossier covering the covered storage, sorting and handling of shredded non-ferrous scrap copper wire. Comply with the Law of 21 March 2017 on Waste Management, register as a waste holder with the Environment Agency, and secure the authorization before commencing operations.
required_dossiers: Site plan and storage capacity details
European Waste Code classification for copper scrap (e.g. EWC 1704 / 12 02 09)
Fire safety and emergency response measures
Environmental impairment liability insurance certificate
Waste handling and duty-of-care records policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality reclassifies the activity as class 1 requiring a full environmental impact assessment, supplement the dossier and await the EIA determination by the Environment Agency; municipal refusal may be contested by administrative appeal and then before the Administrative Tribunal within three months.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie (Ministry of the Economy) for establishment licensing; Administration de l'Environnement and commune authorities for waste and physical premises licensing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Establishment Permit (Autorisation d'établissement) and Waste Management Authorization (Autorisation de gestion des déchets) under the Law of 21 March 2017 on Waste Management

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'Environnement (Luxembourg Environment Agency), 1 avenue du Rock'n'Roll, L-4361 Esch-sur-Alzette
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 (communal authorization) for covered storage and physical handling of non-ferrous scrap; full EIA report reserved for installations exceeding thresholds under the Law of 15 May 2018 on Environmental Impact Assessment and Grand-Ducal implementing regulations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater and run-off discharge limits per Grand-Ducal Regulation of 24 November 1997 on discharges; VOC and dust thresholds for handling operations; waste minimization, segregation, and traceability obligations under the Law of 21 March 2017, including annual waste reporting and duty of care records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGI) for storage and sorting premises; structural load inspection certificate from an approved engineering bureau for warehouse floors and racking; occupational safety clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) under the Luxembourg Labor Code, covering personal protective equipment, first-aid readiness, and operator training records.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT), Luxembourg VAT registration portal via myGuichet.lu; direct taxes: Administration des contributions directes (ACD), portal: eCDF
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign entity: (1) apply for a Luxembourg business registration number (matricule) at Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) via the registered office; (2) file VAT registration application with AEDT using form 640; (3) appoint an accredited VAT fiscal representative if not established in the EU; (4) submit constitutional documents, resolution of managers and proof of business premises; (5) obtain VAT identification number in format LU00000000. Corporate income tax / municipal business tax registration with ACD occurs simultaneously.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — Luxembourg resident SARL is subject to corporate income tax (IRC), municipal business tax and net wealth tax on worldwide income, with territorial sourcing relief under participation exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not offer check-the-box or US-style hybrid classification. Elective regimes include: (i) VAT fiscal unity (assujetti unique) under Article 60 of the Luxembourg VAT law; (ii) fiscal integration / group relief under Article 164bis IRG for companies held directly/indirectly at least 95%; (iii) participation exemption election under Article 166 IRG; (iv) risk-capital deduction under Article 168ter. Hybrid mismatch adjustments apply per EU ATAD.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for resident small enterprises (Article 57 VAT law); no threshold for non-resident suppliers making taxable supplies in Luxembourg; EUR 35,000 for distance-selling of goods to Luxembourg consumers (Article 15a VAT law)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time clearance mandate for B2B. B2G invoices must be e-invoiced in PEPPOL BIS format. All invoices must be issued within 15 days of supply and preserved 10 years; telecommunications/ILI systems or EDI with electronic signature satisfy authenticity and integrity; no digital stamping imposed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated export of recycled scrap copper wire within the meaning of Article 41 of Luxembourg VAT law requires actual physical departure of goods from the EU within 90 days from the supply date; zero rating also applies to transport and ancillary services directly linked to the exported goods and to qualifying triangular supplies under Article 46quater.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'exportation) lodged in Luxembourg or EU customs system
Transport document (Bill of Lading, CMR or Air Waybill) proving receipt outside the EU
Commercial invoice and SWIFT/LC payment receipt (inward remittance evidence) matching the export value
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is scrutinized by the AEDT through periodic audits. Missing substantive export evidence triggers reversal to the 17% standard rate plus late interest of 0.6% per month and fines of up to 100% of the evaded VAT for negligence; criminal penalties for fraudulent claims include imprisonment up to 5 years and/or fines up to EUR 500,000. Retroactive reassessments may extend to six years for fraud, and exporters share joint and several liability with their clients under Article 83 of the VAT law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) within the Eurosystem; monetary policy is delegated to the European Central Bank (ECB); banking conduct and AML/CFT supervision are exercised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF), with the BCL supervising payment and settlement systems (TARGET2/T2, ELIPS national component) and carrying out EU balance-of-payments statistical reporting duties.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Legal-tender currency is the euro (EUR). Full convertibility applies to both current and capital account under Article 63 TFEU; no exchange-control approval, licensing, or quantitative restriction blocks profit remittance, dividend distribution, shareholder loan repayment, or liquidation proceeds. Withholding tax (15% standard dividend WHT, reduced to 5% under the Luxembourg parent-subsidiary regime with tax-residence and holding-period conditions) remains the only material friction on outward profit flows. Banks apply their own enhanced due diligence to remittances involving sanctioned or high-risk third countries, but the Luxembourg statutory regime imposes no conversion obligation and no redemption restriction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable — Luxembourg imposes no statutory surrender, no mandatory repatriation window, and no forced EUR conversion ratio on export receipts. Exporters may freely retain, denominate, or redeploy foreign currency balances. The only administrative requirement is declarative: transactions equal to or exceeding EUR 12,500 must be reported monthly to the BCL for balance-of-payments statistics (implementing Regulation (EC) No 184/2005 and BCL circulars), using the harmonised EU coding taxonomy.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Dedicated Capital Escrow Account (dépôt de capital) plus Operational EUR/USD Current Account
Operational Account with Documentary Credit (LC) line and FX dealing desk
Operational Account with trade finance and SG commodity-desk integration

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de l'Etat (Spuerkeess / BCEE)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (local state-owned bank; stricter sectoral review on metal scrap flows)
Operational Account (standard current account; no dedicated physical commodity desk)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility as an auxiliary payment rail only. Luxembourg-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs, e.g., PayPocket) and EU-passported EMIs can open payment accounts, execute SEPA Credit Transfers and MT103 pass-throughs for open-account collections. They are legally prohibited from granting credit, opening irrevocable documentary credits, issuing guarantees, or maintaining nostro liquidity buffers for LC reimbursement; CSSF requires safeguarding of client funds and compliance with Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 (wire transfer travel rule) and the EBA outsourcing guidelines. Consequently, an offshore EMI cannot replace a tier-1 credit institution for the documentary LC or bulk cross-border settlement layers of this copper-scrap trading mandate, but it may serve as a low-cost operational float account in parallel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person onboarding is the prevailing market practice for a medium-risk enhanced due diligence commodity trader: at least one authorised director and the beneficial owner(s) must attend a physical meeting at the bank's Luxembourg branch (or a recognised foreign branch under internal matrix approval). CSSF allows eIDAS-qualified electronic signatures and supervised video-identification for remote account opening, but in practice tier-1 banks impose physical presence for non-resident UBOs, family-relationship NAV checks, and scrap-metal trade counterparties. Remote signatory mandates are accepted after onboarding only via a Luxembourg notarised powers-of-attorney and qualified e-signature.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsupported source of funds for the SARL registered capital (minimum EUR 12,394.68 fully paid-up) and for subsequent shareholder advances originating from non-EU accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarial incorporation deed allocating shares; bank MT103/SEPA statements of the subscribing shareholder covering at least 12 months; sworn declaration of the source of wealth; board resolution approving the capital increase; audited or accountant-signed confirmation of non-advancement of funds; full CSSF ML/TF reporting exposure of each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Provenance and contamination risk of recycled scrap copper wire: upstream cash transactions, unclear chain of custody, or theft-derived material flagged by law-enforcement databases.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified supplier agreements naming each scrap source; EU Waste Shipment Regulation (Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006) annex documentation; CMR consignment notes; weighbridge tickets; customs export declarations (EXA); spectrographic / mill test certificates; supplier environmental and waste-dealer licences; contractual prohibition on cash settlement above the EUR 10,000 statutory cash limit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nexus of counterparties or bank accounts to EU/UN-sanctioned jurisdictions or FATF high-risk third countries in the copper supply chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-month sanctions and PEP screening results for all UBOs and direct counterparties; EU consolidated financial sanctions list and OFAC SSR self-scan; end-user and anti-diversion undertakings; commodity-flows compliance heat-map; restructuring of the trade route to exclude any sanctioned nexus; full name-screening batch reports retained under CSSF Circular 20/744.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-conformity between the Luxembourg RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) filing and the bank's KYC beneficial-ownership data, or undisclosed indirect control.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date RBE extract published before onboarding; notarised shareholder register; corporate-organisation chart of all natural persons holding more than 25% of ownership or control; copy of any trusts/foundations controlling the SARL; signed UBO declaration using CSSF Form F04.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Letterbox company red flag: no physical Luxembourg substance proportionate to the physical commodity trading activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bail commercial (lease) of a registered office with dedicated premises; employment contracts and social-security (Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale) declarations for resident directors/managers; board meeting minutes held in Luxembourg; profit-and-loss demonstrating management decisions taken in Luxembourg; third-party substance confirmation from an independent service provider.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Statutory capital must be blocked in a dedicated capital escrow account (compte de dépôt de capital) at a Luxembourg credit institution until the notary certifies the subscription; after incorporation the escrow converts into an unrestricted operational account. Wire format uses SWIFT MT103 with ISO 20022 CategoryPurpose codes 'EQUI' (equity capital) or 'CAPH' (capital injection) stated in field 70 / Remittance Information; for euro legs up to EUR 500,000 on the Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA), an equivalent SEPA Credit Transfer with XML 'CtgyPurp' code is accepted. The receiving bank verifies that the remitter is the sole beneficial owner of the funds; remittances above EUR 12,500 trigger a mandatory BCL balance-of-payments declaration to be lodged by the bank within the statutory monthly report and, for capital inflow above the EUR 5 million direct investment threshold, the CSSF/BCL may request supporting evidence of the notarial certificate and immediate source of funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For the settled copper-scrap trade against suppliers in non-EU jurisdictions, the principal clearing rail is an irrevocable Documentary Letter of Credit (UCP 600) issued in SWIFT MT700 via the Luxembourg branch, advised in MT710 and, when required, confirmed by a corridor bank in the seller's country; settlement occurs either by SWIFT MT754/MT202 against presentation of compliant transport and quality documents. For open-account or pre-shipment disbursements, SWIFT MT103 (with 'TRAD' category purpose) is used, converted to TARGET2/T2 for the euro leg and to correspondent banking rails for USD/CNY/MYR legs; all EUR payments within SEPA can alternatively clear through the BCL-operated ELIPS component and EBA CLEARING STEP2. The letter of credit bears the inherent advantage of balancing the cash-to-document cycle against the seller's possession of goods; for this medium-risk commodity the bank imposes standard enhanced documentary requirements: original Bill of Lading/CMR, weightbridge certificate, spectrographic analysis, EU Waste Shipment Regulation Annex VII shipment document, and packing list.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/CNY) covering specified trade invoices and purchase orders, booked under ISDA 2002 or the bank's master agreement with bilateral CSA collateral.
FX swaps (swap de change) managing intra-trade- cycle funding mismatches between the inbound capital leg and the outbound disbursement leg.
Cross-currency swaps (fixed/floating) permitted where the long-term shareholder loan or commercial finance extended to the Luxembourg SARL is denominated in USD or CNY against an EUR balance sheet.
Protective FX options (vanilla calls/puts on EURUSD or EURCNY) as zero-premium or traded for the exclusive mitigation of physical commodity price-to-FX correlation risks.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are legally permissible only where the non-EUR currency leg is non-convertible or restricted (e.g., certain emerging-market counterparties); for freely convertible EUR/USD and EUR/CNY pairs, the bank requires fully deliverable forwards settled through continuous linked settlement (CLS) where applicable.

All derivative transactions are subject to EMIR (Regulation (EU) No 648/2012) trade reporting, clearing thresholds, and risk-mitigation rules, with the Luxembourg entity required to identify its derivative category (financial or non-financial counterparty above the clearing threshold).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual report and audit of annual accounts (financial statements) filed through RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés) via LBR e-Justice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after financial year end; for calendar-year SARL, by 31 July following balance sheet date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 5,000; repeated non-filing for 2 consecutive years triggers official strike-off (radiation d'office) from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual combined corporate tax return (form 1001/1002), including corporate income tax, municipal business tax, and net wealth tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (Luxembourg Inland Revenue / ACD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 May following tax year; extended to 30 June for e-filing; additional extension available upon ACD notification or professional application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 10% tax uplift; monthly late-payment interest of 0.6% on assessed balances; official notice and ex officio assessment issued after failure to file

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT return (form 1000) and annual recapitulative statement for intra-Community supplies of recycled scrap copper wire
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT / Luxembourg VAT Authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 30 April following calendar year; monthly or quarterly PRP returns and EC sales lists apply during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 10,000 in addition to 0.6% monthly late interest; criminal penalty for knowingly false returns or failure to submit VAT statements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmatory declaration of ultimate beneficial owners (UBO register re-validation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – RBE (Registre des Beneficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after the anniversary date of the initial UBO registration; interim UBO update within 30 days of any change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal sanction: imprisonment of 2 months to 2 years and/or fine up to EUR 1,250,000 for legal persons; separate penalty for each failure to confirm

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) required when exceeding at least two of three criteria for two consecutive business years: balance sheet total EUR 4.4 million; net turnover EUR 8.8 million; 50 average employees. Mandatory also for public-interest entities, banks, insurers, and any entity voluntarily appointing a réviseur; shareholder minority request may trigger audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Law of 19 December 2002 on http://legilux.lu and Code de Commerce, implementing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU); IFRS required for listed companies and certain regulated or public-interest entities; small SARL may use abridged format.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each Luxembourg SARL must annually re-confirm the accuracy of its UBO data on the RBE portal no later than one month after anniversary of initial declaration; any share transfer altering control or ownership, which requires SARL-specific transfer formalities (private deed or notarial instrument and, for third-party transferees, duly approved by qualifying-75% shareholder resolution), must be reported as an updated UBO declaration within 30 days. Failure to do so carries criminal penalties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des associés) reflecting shares, transfers, pledges, and ownership history
Register of Directors and Managers (registre des gérants) with mandates, resignations, and powers
Register of Share Transfers and pending contracts of transfer
Minute Book of annual general meetings, extraordinary meetings, and managing director resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,200 – 6,500 per annum (professional domiciliation services and local corporate agent)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,500 – 22,000 per annum (mandatory if thresholds met; voluntary audit fee at small-SARL market rates)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 17% (bracketed: 15% on first EUR 175,000; 16% on EUR 175,001–200,000; 17% above EUR 200,000). Aggregate marginal rate including 7% unemployment solidarity surcharge and Luxembourg City communal business tax of 6.75% equals approximately 24.94%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 100% participation exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains; 80% deduction for qualifying IP income (IP box, residual effective CIT rate approx. 3.4%); SME investment tax credit of 12% on first EUR 150,000 of new qualifying investments (7% beyond), plus 9%/8% credits for digital and energy-transition investments; notional interest deduction on qualifying new equity (subject to ongoing state-aid scrutiny).
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no statutory expiry; perpetual carryforward under Art. 114 LIR, forfeited only if more than 75% of the share capital is transferred and the business activity is discontinued or substantially altered within the same fiscal year).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Model 202 – Declaration for corporate income tax (impôt sur le revenu des collectivités), municipal business tax (impôt commercial communal) and net wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune); mandatory electronic filing via MyGuichet.lu (eFiling module of the Administration des contributions directes).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (one return per fiscal year; generally the calendar year unless a different accounting period was approved by the tax administration).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 31 December of the year following the fiscal year-end (e.g., fiscal year ending 31.12.2024 is due 31.12.2025); a reasoned extension may be requested through MyGuichet.lu before the expiry of the statutory deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RCS number, legal form (SARL), name, registered office, national identification number, NACE code 4669, VAT number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a certified translation of the articles of association, the extract from the Luxembourg Register of Commerce, and the list of managers; identify the non-resident direct and indirect shareholder and each beneficial owner's country of tax residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Start and end dates of the fiscal year; for a short first period use the exact actual dates in the balance sheet and profit and loss account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A short first fiscal year must be reported in full without pro-rating the 15%/16%/17% brackets; reconciliation between the RCS-filed accounts and the Model 202 period is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit or loss per the statutory annual accounts before corporate income tax; reconciliation of accounting income to taxable income, including add-backs of non-deductible expenses and exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: File the audit report of the réviseur d'entreprises agréé where statutory thresholds are exceeded; for scrap copper consignment, append purchase/sale contracts, warehouse receipts, shipping documents (B/L or CMR) and LME price confirmations supporting the gross margin.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 104 – Participation exemption and exempt income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Qualifying dividends and capital gains exempted under Art. 166 LIR; other non-taxable income claimed as deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the share register, acquisition cost evidence, holding-period calculation (at least 12 months), and, for capital gains, evidence that the participation was at least EUR 6 million or 10% of the subsidiary's capital.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 107 – Taxable income before loss carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base for corporate income tax after all add-backs and deductions; deduction of available loss carryforwards (Art. 114 LIR) is then computed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify that intra-group trading margins for non-ferrous scrap fall within the OECD interquartile range and that no artificial pass-through invoicing reduces the Luxembourg taxable base; attach the loss-carryforward schedule if prior-year losses are utilized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 130 – Municipal business tax and net wealth tax schedules
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjustments for communal business tax (including 50% add-back of long-term interest expense); net wealth tax base at 0.5% with the EUR 500,000 exemption and the 15-year non-deduction rule for shareholdings and intra-group receivables.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A trading SARL does not qualify for the net-wealth-tax exemption available to pure holding or intra-group financing companies; declare all Luxembourg bank accounts and explain the commercial substance of each balance-sheet position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annex – Intra-group transactions / Transfer pricing statement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of all related-party transactions (purchases, sales, commissions, financial charges) exceeding EUR 500,000 per year and confirmation that transfer pricing documentation is maintained and available on request.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Luxembourg manager must sign and retain the Local File, including a functional analysis and comparability study for wholesale trading of recovered copper; benchmark the resale margin using TNMM or the LME CUP for primary metal.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of EUR 250–2,500 per return; if no return is filed after a reminder, the ACD assesses the tax ex officio (taxation d'office) with a mandatory 10% increase of the assessed tax; late payment interest accrues at 0.6% per month on the outstanding amount. Failure to produce transfer pricing documentation upon request triggers a fine of up to EUR 25,000 and the burden of proof shifts to the taxpayer. Managers are jointly liable for penalties caused by their intentional or grossly negligent breach of filing duties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% standard Luxembourg withholding tax on SARL dividend distributions. Exemptions: 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for a corporate EU shareholder with a 10% holding held 12 months; 0% under Art. 147 LIR for any non-resident parent company holding 10% (or an acquisition cost of at least EUR 1.2 million) for 12 months; DTA rates generally 5% for qualifying corporate holdings and 15% for portfolio investors.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: (1) Before paying a dividend, the Luxembourg SARL must obtain the shareholder's certificate of tax residence (Formulaire 22 / TRC in the format required by the applicable DTA) plus a beneficial ownership statement. (2) The manager files a request for exemption or reduction at source ('demande de renonciation à la retenue à la source') with the competent ACD bureau before the distribution; the approved waiver allows payment at the treaty rate. (3) If no waiver was obtained in advance, the 15% tax is withheld and the shareholder must file a refund claim with the ACD within the statutory limitation period, which is generally five years from the end of the relevant tax year. (4) The SARL must retain the TRC, board minutes authorizing the distribution, and the payment receipts for ten years; failure to obtain substance evidence may trigger an MLI Principal Purpose Test challenge to the treaty claim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: 0% Luxembourg withholding tax on outbound interest under domestic law (no DTA threshold needed; exceptions apply solely to profit-participating loans). Royalties: 0% Luxembourg withholding tax on outbound royalty payments to non-residents. Luxembourg therefore operates as a pure pass-through jurisdiction for debt interest and IP royalty flows, and no application to the ACD is required for such payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 500,000 of annual intra-group ordinary revenue triggers the mandatory simplified transfer pricing statement annexed to the Model 202; a full Local File and Master File are required for Luxembourg entities belonging to groups with consolidated turnover of at least EUR 750 million; Country-by-Country Reporting applies to groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (with LME spot and futures quotations for copper as the natural external benchmark)
Resale Price Method (for buy-sell distribution of scrap)
TNMM (preferred for routine wholesale distribution functions; requires interquartile range benchmarking)
Profit Split Method (for integrated trading and risk-bearing functions)
